tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get an event's details, participants and time options with per-option vote tallies and who voted. Identify the event with the token from the personal link (the last part of /e/{token}): an organizer owner_token or a participant share_token. Also returns your_response per option.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Look up the event a token belongs to. Pass the token from a personal link (/e/{token}); returns the event id and name.

tools.name: add_time_option
tools.description: Propose a time option for an event. The organizer (owner_token) can always add options; participants (share_token) only if the event allows it.

tools.name: vote_time_option
tools.description: Vote yes/no/maybe on a proposed time. The token decides who is voting: an owner_token votes as the organizer, a share_token as that participant.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Get a compact availability summary for an event: each time option with yes/maybe/no counts, who voted, and your own response. Identify the event with an owner_token or share_token (the last part of /e/{token}).

tools.name: add_participant
tools.description: Add a participant to an event. Returns the new participant's share_token (their personal link is /e/{share_token}). The organizer can always add participants; participants only if the event allows it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_event" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get details of an event, including per-time-option vote tallies and who voted. Pass share_token to also get your own vote per option." → after: "Get an event's details, participants and time options with per-option vote tallies and who voted. Identify the event with the token from the personal link (the last part of /e/{token}): an organizer owner_token or a participant share_token. Also returns your_response per option."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
